What does this enhancement of readUrlSegment have to do with getNthStringFromPath ?

I guess it is "The existing URI functions were found to not accept fragments (given they are rarely used in PATCH).  Add support for fragments to cover the getNthStringFromPath use cases."

So for the unit tests. Could have been a separate commit but I'm good with it here.

Basically, this is the helper function we need to use to replace getNthStringFromPath, but this is one of the few places where we handle fragments.

Fair, this could've been a separate commit, but I didn't want to check in dead code.  Probably would've been fine either way.

So this function finds the D-Bus for the given chassis name.. So given a chassis name of "chassis0", it should be able to find 
/xyz/openbmc_project/inventory/system/chassis/chassis0.. 

But it is bad.. It has some bad assumptions.. 
1) We shouldn't assume chassis is at the 5th element 
2) I think that ends_with has imprecise matching 
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/eb261e1f5455575234246764e73ef07d4a50031b/docs/COMMON_ERRORS.md?plain=1#L300

chassis should equal value.. 
Oh well. This function is a mess. You don't make it any worse.

I think it is mostly just checking for a D-Bus object.  
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/eb261e1f5455575234246764e73ef07d4a50031b/redfish-core/lib/openbmc/openbmc_managers.hpp#L615
This whole function can probably go away in lieu of one of the newer helpers at some point.
